title: Hold a licence to conduct a collection
what: Conduct a charitable collection only under a licence.

sources.title: Charitable Collections Act 2003 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 14(1) (current republication (R15, from 6 December 2025; Charitable Collections Act 2003 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person conducts a collection; and (b) the person is not authorised by a licence to conduct the collection
